interpretation.binary_brier: Legacy binary definition: (1 - probability of correct label)^2, without a factor of two.
interpretation.binary_nll: Legacy binary definition: -log(max(probability of correct label, 1e-12)).
interpretation.mc1_accuracy: Argmax over MC1 answer choices; best-answer target is index zero.
interpretation.mc1_brier: Categorical multiclass Brier: sum over MC1 choices of (probability - one-hot best-answer target)^2; not the binary Brier definition.
interpretation.mc1_nll: Unclipped categorical negative log probability of best answer, computed as logsumexp(raw summed loglikelihoods) minus best-answer loglikelihood.
interpretation.mc2: Softmax probability mass on true-labeled MC2 answer choices; not binary accuracy.
interpretation.outcome_counts: Counts use strictly positive/negative marginal CI bounds, separately for MC1 gain versus MC1 ECE and MC2 gain versus MC1 ECE; crossing or touching zero is uncertain.
interpretation.overconfidence_gap: Mean confidence minus accuracy within the relevant benchmark; positive is overconfidence.
interpretation.scope: Descriptive matched comparisons on fixed questions/models, not causal or family-population effects. Marginal 95% intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. Outcome counts do not constitute a joint significance test.
interpretation.standard_calibration: Confidence, overconfidence, Brier, NLL and ECE concern MC1 categorical best-answer probabilities, not MC2 truth-mass classification.
